characters.name: Gladias
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Veridia thread; a Keeper in the Order of Steering, husband of Seila, father of Zven and Lily. Thoughtful, earnest, calm and curious; in these chapters more confident and argumentative (pitches the court case to the judges), tender with his family. Occasionally speaks slow, careful Dzegoban.

characters.name: Zei
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Dzego thread; national Minpentai champion and gifted cryptographer, now supervising drone combat for the Kungaupei and Veridia. Quick, precise, fluent technical explainer; playful with friends; tense, despairing and then elated during the battles (ch26, ch29-30). Occasionally speaks Dzegoban.

characters.name: Verdow
characters.age: adult (senator, middle-aged or older; has a daughter)
characters.voice_notes: Senator Verdow: warm, jovial, quick to laugh, internationally minded; the senator Gladias trusts. Gives long reflective, philosophical speeches (law in ch25, society and the future in ch32).

notes: No exceptions: G is Gladias, Z is Zei, V is Senator Verdow throughout. From 25:120 Verdow is the remote party on a call with Gladias and Zei. N-coded written text left to the narrator: the binary grids Zei writes on his hand device (25:48, 25:56, 25:64) and the outgoing message header typed by Gladias (25:117). All attributions confident.
